views.caveat: Every share is of the cohort's patients with a sample profiled for TP53 (a panel listing it, or whole-exome): 171 in “Basal-like”, 499 in “Luminal A”. Each protein change counts the patients carrying it in one of the cohort's samples; uncalled mutations are left out, VUS and germline mutations kept, as on the portal. p is a two-sided Fisher's exact test of carriers against the rest of the profiled patients, per change; q is Benjamini–Hochberg across the 132 changes listed. A stem's height is the distinct patient + protein change pairs at that codon, as a share of the profiled patients, as the portal draws it. The gene picker ranks genes by their higher share of mutated samples over profiled samples in the two cohorts, as the portal's does. Driver = OncoKB oncogenic (v7.5).

steps.title: Rank genes by their higher mutated share
steps.detail: The mutcompare:mutated / panels / wes queries above: per gene, the cohort's samples with a called mutation, and the samples profiled for it (a panel listing it, or whole-exome). Genes are ordered by the higher of the two cohorts' shares, as the portal's gene picker orders them.

steps.title: Count each protein change's patients in TP53
steps.detail: The lollipop queries above, once per cohort: per (codon, protein change), the distinct patients carrying it in one of the cohort's samples; and the cohort's patients profiled for TP53 (mutcompare:profiled).

steps.title: Fisher's exact test per protein change, then Benjamini–Hochberg
steps.detail: Carriers against the rest of the profiled patients, two-sided, per change; q across the changes listed. The log ratio is log2 of the first cohort's share over the second's.

method.verification: Fisher's exact test matches scipy 1.18.1 fisher_exact and Benjamini–Hochberg statsmodels multipletests, to a relative 1e-6 (test/tables-golden.test.ts).
